summary: Braskem S.A. filed a Form 6-K disclosing the consolidated summary statement of remote voting for its Ordinary General Meeting held on April 29, 2026. The filing covers standard agenda items including approval of financial statements, management accounts, and board elections under CVM Resolution No. 81/22. There are no disclosed terms relating to a merger, acquisition, tender offer, restructuring, or any other special situation. The filing is a routine proxy disclosure for an annual shareholder meeting, analogous to a U.S. definitive proxy statement. No event-specific catalyst or risk-arbitrage angle is present.
